title: Zophar Speaks: God's Ways Are Higher

questions.question: Who is the third friend to speak?
questions.explanation: Job 11:1 (ESV): "Then Zophar the Naamathite answered and said:"

questions.question: What does Zophar call Job?
questions.explanation: Job 11:2 (ESV): "Should a multitude of words go unanswered, and a man full of talk be judged right?"

questions.question: What does Zophar say Job claims regarding his doctrine?
questions.explanation: Job 11:4 (ESV): "For you say, 'My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in your eyes.'"

questions.question: What does Zophar wish God would do?
options: Speak and open his lips against you
questions.correctAnswer: Speak and open his lips against you
questions.explanation: Job 11:5 (ESV): "But oh, that God would speak and open his lips against you,"

questions.question: If you prepare your heart, what will happen?
options: You will stretch out your hands toward him
questions.correctAnswer: You will stretch out your hands toward him
questions.explanation: Job 11:13 (ESV): "If you prepare your heart, you will stretch out your hands toward him."

questions.question: Can you find out the deep things of God?
questions.explanation: Job 11:7 (ESV): "Can you find out the deep things of God? Can you find out the limit of the Almighty?"

questions.question: They are higher than what?
questions.explanation: Job 11:8 (ESV): "It is higher than heaven—what can you do? Deeper than Sheol—what can you know?"

questions.question: God exacts of you less than your what?
questions.explanation: Job 11:6 (ESV): "Know then that God exacts of you less than your guilt deserves."

questions.question: What is longer than the earth and broader than the sea?
questions.explanation: Job 11:9 (ESV): "Its measure is longer than the earth and broader than the sea."

questions.question: What will happen to your life if you put iniquity far away?
options: It will be brighter than the noonday
questions.correctAnswer: It will be brighter than the noonday
questions.explanation: Job 11:17 (ESV): "And your life will be brighter than the noonday; its darkness will be like the morning."

questions.question: A stupid man will get understanding when what happens?
options: When a wild donkey's colt is born a man
questions.correctAnswer: When a wild donkey's colt is born a man
questions.explanation: Job 11:12 (ESV): "But a stupid man will get understanding when a wild donkey's colt is born a man."

questions.question: If God passes through and imprisons and assembles for judgment, who can what?
questions.explanation: Job 11:10 (ESV): "If he passes through and imprisons and assembles for judgment, who can hinder him?"

questions.question: What will fail the wicked?
questions.explanation: Job 11:20 (ESV): "But the eyes of the wicked will fail; all way of escape will be lost to them..."

questions.question: What is the hope of the wicked?
questions.explanation: Job 11:20 (ESV): "...and their hope is to breathe their last."

questions.question: You will take your rest in what?
questions.explanation: Job 11:18 (ESV): "...you will look around and take your rest in security."

key_verse_text: Can you find out the deep things of God? Can you find out the limit of the Almighty?
